name: ProductionChecklist
title: Templates/Platform/Detail/ProductionChecklist
summary: A production checklist on a resource overview: a card that names the gates between the generated hostname and production, counts how many are done and lists each as a row, with an expand button that opens the same list as a drawer where every step carries its description and its action. Once every gate is done the card collapses to its title with a Ready for production Tag. Rendered on a resource’s Overview tab. Built from `Card`, `Item`, `Tag`, `IconButton`, `Drawer`, the `Panel` parts and `Button`.

variants.name: Complete
variants.summary: Every gate done: the Tag turns into a success Ready for production, the rows are gone and the header loses its bottom border, so the card closes down to its title and the expand button.

variants.name: DrawerDetail
variants.summary: The expand button opens a right-side drawer with the same progress Tag, the checklist description, every step with its description, and either its action or, once done, a Tag with what it now serves, over a Done footer.
